raw: {"triples": [{"subject": "Annotation", "predicate": "uses", "object": "GermaNet", "object_type": "Other", "source_sentence": "Following the approach of Choi and Wiebe (2014), we want to annotate word senses in GermaNet V9.0 , the sister resource to Word- Net for German , that can serve both as training / seed data for automatic methods for graph-based label propagation, and also as a gold standard for evaluating automatic methods."}, {"subject": "Annotation", "predicate": "uses", "object": "BabelNet", "object_type": "Other", "source_sentence": "Using the German lemma information and the POS information in BabelNet, we next extracted 998 unique synsets from GermaNet that contained any word senses for the lemmas found in the 273 BabelNet synsets."}]}

{"triples": [{"subject": "Annotation", "predicate": "uses", "object": "annotation guidelines", "object_type": "Concept", "source_sentence": "In the exploratory phase I, we annotated 226 GermaNet synsets following the annotation guidelines for EffectWordNet by Choi and Wiebe (2014)."}, {"subject": "Annotation", "predicate": "uses", "object": "scheme presented in §4", "object_type": "Concept", "source_sentence": "In phase II, we annotated 500 synsets using the scheme presented in §4."}, {"subject": "Annotation", "predicate": "uses", "object": "syntactic valence information about the entity affected", "object_type": "Concept", "source_sentence": "It allows for the annotation of more opinion inference-relevant predicates and it takes into account syntactic valence information about the entity affected."}]}
